本地 API 文档，一键接入: Connect local API docs to Codex
查找你的 Javadoc，验证连接，让 Codex 根据真实文档编写宏。: Find your Javadoc and verify the connection so Codex can write macros using real API documentation.
留空扫描常见安装位置，或输入安装目录、HTML 文档目录、ZIP/JAR 路径。: Leave blank to search common locations, or enter an installation folder, HTML documentation folder, or ZIP/JAR path.
路径留空时搜索常见安装位置；支持目录及 ZIP/JAR 文档包。: Leave blank for common locations. Supports folders and ZIP/JAR archives.
02 选择与你的仿真版本对应的文档: 02   Select docs for your simulation version
先扫描，再选择文档: Scan first, then select your docs
没有安装 STAR-CCM+？也可以选择已有的 Javadoc 压缩包。: You can also select a Javadoc archive without a local STAR-CCM+ installation.
选择文档后，可先验证，再接入 Codex。: Select documentation, then verify it or connect it to Codex.
留空自动发现 node.exe: Leave blank to find node.exe automatically.
留空自动发现 codex.exe / codex.cmd / codex.ps1: Leave blank to find codex.exe / codex.cmd / codex.ps1 automatically.
扫描不会修改 Codex 配置。: Scanning does not change Codex configuration.
日志文件无法保存；可使用“复制日志”保留当前输出。: The log file could not be saved. Use Copy log to preserve the output.
搜索范围已更新，请重新扫描。: The search location changed. Please scan again.
路径留空时搜索常见安装位置。: Leave the path blank to search common installation locations.
可先验证文档，或验证并接入 Codex。: Verify the documentation, or verify and connect it to Codex.
旧版文档：支持查类和读页面；没有成员索引时不能按方法名搜索。: Legacy docs support class search and page reading. Searching methods requires a member index.
已选择带搜索索引的文档。请确认版本与你的仿真一致。: Selected indexed documentation. Check that its version matches your simulation.
服务名称只能包含英文字母、数字、下划线和连字符。: The server name may contain only letters, digits, underscores and hyphens.
请稍候，可以随时停止扫描。: Please wait. You can stop the scan at any time.
正在执行后台任务，请勿关闭窗口。详细输出见下方日志。: Verification is running. Please keep this window open. Expand the log for details.
后台运行中，窗口会持续更新。: Running in the background. This window will keep updating.
后台任务未成功完成（退出码 {0}）。请查看日志。: The background operation failed (exit code {0}). Check the log.
可以开始扫描文档。: You can now scan for documentation.
仍可扫描文档；在高级选项中指定缺少的程序路径，再刷新环境。: Scanning is still available. Specify missing programs in Advanced options, then check the environment again.
尝试选择安装目录、文档压缩包，或启用全盘扫描。: Try an installation folder, a documentation archive, or a full-drive scan.
请确认已安装 Java API 文档；程序 JAR 不等于 Javadoc。: Check that the Java API documentation is installed. Binary program JARs are not Javadoc.
选择与你的仿真版本对应的文档，再进行验证或接入。: Select documentation matching your simulation version, then verify or connect it.
验证未写入 Codex 配置。现在可以点击“验证并接入 Codex”。: Codex configuration was not changed. You can now select Verify and connect to Codex.
请重启 Codex，再让它调用 search_api 和 get_doc 完成会: Restart Codex, then ask it to call search_api and get_doc to verify the session.
可以调整范围后重新扫描。: Adjust the search location and scan again.
调整目录可缩小扫描范围。: Choose a more specific folder to narrow the search.
仍可扫描文档，或点击“刷新环境”重新检查。: You can still scan documents, or select Check environment to try again.
选择 STAR-CCM+ 安装目录或 Javadoc 文件夹: Select a STAR-CCM+ installation or Javadoc folder
请刷新环境，或重新验证所选文档。: Check the environment again, or reverify the selected documentation.
剪贴板暂时被占用，请稍后重试。: The clipboard is busy. Please try again.
报告目录已不存在；可复制界面中保留的日志。: The report folder no longer exists. You can copy the log retained in this window.
验证或配置写入尚未结束，请稍候再关闭窗口。: Verification or configuration is still running. Please wait before closing this window.
后台任务没有返回结果，请检查日志。: The background operation returned no result. Please check the log.
